fields.description: Run the full backup and upload automatically every day at 02:30.
fields.label: Enable Scheduled Backup

fields.description: Remote name as in rclone.conf, e.g. onedrive or onedrive:Backups.
fields.label: rclone Remote

fields.description: Folder inside the remote to write backups to, e.g. ERPNextBackups.
fields.label: Destination Folder

fields.description: Leave blank to use the default (~/.config/rclone/rclone.conf).
fields.label: rclone Config Path

fields.description: Paste the full rclone.conf here (run rclone config show on the Odoo server). The app reads your OneDrive/SharePoint connection straight from it — no rclone install needed.
fields.label: Microsoft 365 Config (paste rclone.conf)

fields.description: Microsoft tenant for login. Leave blank for "common" (works for most setups).
fields.label: Tenant (optional)

fields.description: Run an automatic backup every N hours (e.g. 24 = once a day, 12 = twice a day).
fields.label: Backup Every (hours)

fields.description: Keep the latest N backup folders in the cloud; older folders are deleted. Each backup goes into its own timestamped folder.
fields.label: Backup Slots (keep last N)

fields.description: Who to notify after every backup — email addresses or ERPNext user names, comma- or newline-separated (a user's email is taken from their User profile). Uses the site's outgoing email account.
fields.label: Email Recipients

fields.description: Email body. Same placeholders as the subject.
fields.label: Email Message

fields.description: Run a non-interactive rclone command against the configured remote, e.g. listremotes, config show, lsd onedrive:, about onedrive:.
fields.label: Command
